# Brite Smile Dental Care

> Multi-speciality dental clinic in Charbagh, Lucknow, led by Dr. Priyank Prakash (24+ years experience). Offers implants, teeth whitening, root canal, orthodontics, and more.

Trusted by 5,000+ patients with a 4.9 Google rating. Located near Charbagh Railway Station, serving Aryanagar, Aishbagh, Hazratganj, Gomti Nagar, and Alambagh areas of Lucknow. Open Mon–Fri 10am–1pm & 5:30pm–9pm, Sat–Sun 10am–1pm.
